name: Wuxi Huaguang Environment & Energy Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Huaguang Environment & Energy Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the energy and environmental protection business. The company provides circulating fluidized bed boilers, pulverized coal boilers, waste incineration boilers, biomass boilers, gas turbine waste heat boilers, and desulfurization and denitrification equipment. It also provides engineering, procurement, and construction services for traditional thermal power and new energy photovoltaic power plants; thermal power operation and related power services; photovoltaic power generation and operation services.
